				// m_hMyWeapons free slot). The ZPS value 272 resolves to a weapon fire-sound fn
				// (0x31fda0) and is wrong. GiveNamedItem(400) spawns the weapon but does NOT equip
				// it for fake clients, so WeaponEquip(261) must be called right after GivePlayerItem.
